newsitem.title: USA: US to consider more food aid for N.Korea -Albright.
newsitem.headline: US to consider more food aid for N.Korea -Albright.

text.p: The United States will consider sending additional food aid for famine victims in North Korea, Secretary of State Madeleine Albright said on Wednesday.
"We have been a major donor through the World Food Programme and have done a great deal and will see whether we can do more," Albright told journalists.

Asked why Washington would give more aid to such a hardline communist country, Albright replied, "We have a record, frankly, of caring about people; often people are the victims of their government...
"It is the right thing to do, but it is, I think, pragmatically important for our long-term goal for the peninsula," she said.
She said the United States would not consider a North Korean request to withdraw U.S. troops from the demilitarized zone on the Korean peninsula.
"We are not going to do that. This is the last area of the Cold War," Albright said.
